title: Maricel Soriano, Maris Racal tie for Best Actress at 42nd Star Awards; Vilma Santos gets standing ovation
summary: Kapamilya artists Maricel Soriano ("Meet, Greet, and Bye") and Maris Racal ("Sunshine") tied for Best Actress at the 42nd Star Awards for Movies, held on Sunday at Winford in Manila.
